reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Proposed acute isogenic p53 depletion and near-endogenous rescue, separate caffeine perturbation, longitudinal and fixed cell-cycle/death measurements.

checks.quote: ### Recommended Next Action and Proposed Conclusion
checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of prior Methods, supplements or validated protocols to select conditions and check transfer to this system.

checks.quote: Add IAA 4 hours prior
checks.reason: No untagged auxin or matched inducer/cassette procedural control. Depleted and rescued cells also receive different IAA exposure durations, leaving a manipulation-time alternative to p53 rescue.

checks.quote: ### Recommended Next Action and Proposed Conclusion
checks.reason: No identity, contamination, passage or sequence-integrity verification for the parental/engineered system.

checks.quote: Auxin-Inducible Degron (AID)
checks.reason: The chosen AID workflow omits expression of the required auxin receptor/E3 adaptor and concrete engineering/delivery preparation. An AID tag plus IAA alone is not an executable mammalian degradation system; primary mechanism: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19915560/ .

checks.quote: ### Recommended Next Action and Proposed Conclusion
checks.reason: No assay blanks/positive incorporation or death standards, detector calibration, compensation or objective gate-accuracy acceptance and repair rules.

checks.quote: proportion of live cells
checks.reason: Survivor-only G1 fractions and excluded dead/debris events lack an original-cohort denominator, absolute recovery and unknown-track rules, so selective loss can change the endpoint.

checks.quote: at least three independent biological replicates
checks.reason: Independent days are named, but no pilot variance, precision or power plan justifies the treatment replicate count.

checks.quote: no statistically significant difference in baseline
checks.reason: A nonsignificant baseline test is not an equivalence criterion; real p53-dependent baseline shifts are automatically treated as toxicity requiring recalibration rather than retained biological outcomes.

checks.quote: standardized mean difference (or ANOVA interaction term)
checks.reason: The primary treated-only comparison does not define the genotype-by-damage difference-in-differences estimand. No clustered uncertainty, equivalence or multiplicity procedure is supplied.

checks.quote: a dose that maximizes the proportion of cells in G1 arrest
checks.reason: Maximal arrest with viable cells does not measure matched initial DNA lesions across p53 states. No independent initial-lesion assay is proposed.

checks.quote: 2D dose-response matrix
checks.reason: No bounded agent/caffeine concentration exploration or rule deriving its bounds before confirmation.

checks.quote: ### Recommended Next Action and Proposed Conclusion
checks.reason: Redesign/recalibration is not followed by a specified protocol refreeze and fresh independent confirmation.

checks.quote: cessation of division events
checks.reason: Cessation of division is not G1-specific; no phase-resolved live reporter or registered trajectory confirms sustained original-cohort G1 rather than G2/delay. A significant reduction alone also cannot establish necessity.

checks.quote: ### Recommended Next Action and Proposed Conclusion
checks.reason: No linked raw trajectories, cytometry files, sample identifiers and exact analysis/code/settings provenance.

checks.quote: ### Recommended Next Action and Proposed Conclusion
checks.reason: Clearly proposed factorial design and correct untagged rescue concept, randomized blinded acquisition and basic depletion/rescue and toxicity diagnostics. Live death and fixed incorporation/DNA provide complementary measurements, but the primary endpoint and actual G1 inference do not exploit them validly. Specific calibration, damage-matching and decision deductions own those defects without duplicate general penalties.
